affliction.line: "I have tried thee," it is written, "in the furnace of affliction"
stanza: I came all this way to see your grave
To see your life as writ in paraphrase
"I have tried thee," it is written, "in the furnace of affliction"
This is what you couldn't face
She is benediction
She is addicted to thee
She is the root connection
She is connecting with he

conviction.line: How can you call me with such conviction?
stanza: I ran out of made-up consolations
I've been waitin' forever
How can you call me with such conviction?
"Sugar cane, sugar"
You get yourself out of situations
Won't you leave me, won't you?
'Cause I don't have the time for indignations
"Sugar cane, sugar"

conviction.line: I guess I don't mind losing my conviction
stanza: When I could spend the weekend out on a bender
Do I get callous or do I stay tender?
Which of these is worse and which is better?
Dying to myself virtually, a massacre
A character of somebody's invention
A martyr in another passion play
I guess I don't mind losing my conviction
If it's all relative fiction anyway

crucifixion.line: Flowers don't speak, but they speak to each other of a crucifixion
stanza: There is a hill near Jerusalem that wild flowers grow upon
Flowers don't speak, but they speak to each other of a crucifixion
Just because he said he was the son of God
And the fury of the moment they felt they could only silently look upon
Every city bar brawl, every fist-fight, every bullet from a gun
It's written upon the palms of the Holy One
Every city bar brawl, every fist-fight, every bullet from a gun
It's written in the palms, in the palms of the Holy One

fiction.line: So we're covered up in fiction
stanza: So we're covered up in fiction
Chasing something true
But darling, damn the luck
And damn the consequences too
I could bury all the memories
I could patch up all the holes
But I'd still feel your fingers on my soul

fiction.line: He's a walkin' contradiction, partly truth and partly fiction
stanza: He's a poet and he's a picker, he's a prophet and he's a pusher
He's a pilgrim and a preacher and a problem when he's stoned
He's a walkin' contradiction, partly truth and partly fiction
Takin' every wrong direction on his lonely way back home

prediction.line: Where everything was fiction, future, and prediction
stanza: Sitting at the bed with the halo at your head
Was it all a disguise, like junior high?
Where everything was fiction, future, and prediction
Now, where am I? My fading supply
